title: Emerald Finance Ltd - 538882 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Emerald Finance H1 FY27 PAT up 49.8% to Rs10.18 Cr, but gold-loan volumes down 30-35% and partner funding cuts show distribution income is shrinking; no capacity or capex discussion.

summary.headline: Emerald Finance Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT rose 47.14% YoY to INR5.30 crores on total income of INR10.07 crores (+45.81%).
summary.overview: Consolidated Q2 FY27 total income was INR10.07 crores (+45.81% YoY) and PAT was INR5.30 crores (+47.14% YoY); H1 FY27 total income was INR19.51 crores (+42.94%) and PAT INR10.18 crores (+49.80%). Management said EBITDA rose 54.75% YoY to INR8.39 crores, attributing it to flat consolidated salary and overhead costs. Gold loan distribution weakened on RBI DSA norms, lower gold prices and tighter credit at partner NBFCs, with management guiding to recovery in the next two quarters. The company launched the Emerald Ekam financial wellness platform and onboarded 24 corporates in Q2.

financial_highlights.metric: Impairment loss on financial assets (Q2 FY27)
financial_highlights.change: vs INR21.2 lakhs in Q1 FY27

segments.name: Interest income / MSME lending
segments.commentary: Management stated MSME loan book at INR131 crores currently, targeting above INR150 crores by year-end; average ticket about INR40 lakhs at about 18% yield. Interest income was 49% of Q2 revenue.

segments.name: Distribution (gold loan syndication and others)
segments.commentary: Distribution was 39.2% of Q2 revenue but the moderator's question noted a declining trend over recent quarters. Gold loan syndication fell to about INR80 crores per month via HDFC and ICICI versus about INR125 crores in Q4 FY26; management cited 30-35% degrowth in gold loan volume.

segments.name: Earned Wage Access (EWA)
segments.commentary: EWA was 11.8% of Q2 revenue. Monthly EWA disbursement averages about INR14 crores, with cross-sell adding about INR16 crores per month; 270 corporate partners, with 5,500 of about 40,000-42,000 employees transacting monthly (about 12-14% activation).

guidance_outlook: Management expects Q3 and Q4 FY27 to be better than Q1 and Q2, citing festive-season EWA demand and the March quarter.
EWA disbursement is expected to grow at least 15-20% quarter-on-quarter.
MSME AUM expected to cross INR150 crores by end of FY27, described as conservative.
Corporate onboarding target for FY27 is 120; about 50% achieved at half-year, with 24 added in Q2.
Gold loan volumes expected to pick up in the next two quarters if gold prices stabilise; annual syndication target of about INR1,300 crores stated as achievable.
NSE listing eligibility expected after the March 2027 audited balance sheet (net worth above INR75 crores requirement).
capex_capacity: Emerald Ekam, an integrated financial wellness platform (salary access, loans, investments, insurance, benefits), launched with soft launch under way; existing corporate clients being migrated to it.
Gold loan partners: Unity Small Finance Bank signed as lead facilitator for bank-transfer funding (second pan-India partner); another private sector bank expected to be announced shortly.
Digital gold available via SafeGold tie-up on Emerald Ekam; silver not yet offered.
Education loans recently started; mortgage and personal loan businesses described as growing.
Target of 120 corporates for FY27; management said focus is now on large corporates in India.
demand_pricing: Gold loan syndication volumes declined about 30-35% due to RBI DSA regulation, falling gold prices and fewer balance-transfer cases; a moderator-cited figure put volumes at INR290 crores versus INR375 crores in Q4.
Two or three large NBFC partners reportedly saw funding fall 40-50% as credit norms tightened.
EWA IRR about 30-36%, ticket size from INR100 up to INR1 lakh; retention rate in EWA stated at 90%.
Management said bankers have not raised rates yet, but State Bank and ICICI could pass on any further 25 bps RBI hike.
Average employee engagement on EWA is about 12-14%; management says cross-selling aims to lift usage.

qa_highlights.question: Status of NSE listing plans?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the company is on track and eligible after the March 2027 audited balance sheet, citing a net worth requirement of above INR75 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Why has distribution income declined over recent quarters?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited tighter credit norms at partner NBFCs (funding down 40-50% at two or three), RBI tightening of gold loan distribution policy, and falling gold prices.

qa_highlights.question: Impairment loss and borrowing cost outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Impairment was INR21.2 lakhs in Q1 and INR28.8 lakhs in Q2. Existing bankers have not raised rates; further pass-through possible if RBI hikes another 25 bps.

qa_highlights.question: Is MSME lending profitable and what is the AUM outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: MSME AUM is INR131 crores, expected to exceed INR150 crores by year-end. Average tenure about 2 years (minimum 3 months), mostly trading borrowers, average ticket about INR40 lakhs at about 18% yield.

qa_highlights.question: Is the EBITDA improvement sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed it to flat consolidated salary and overhead costs with technology and AI use, and said current margins are sustainable.

qa_highlights.question: Gold loan demand and syndication target?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said volumes fell 30-35% due to falling gold prices and fewer balance-transfer cases; new bank tie-ups are expected to help, and the INR1,300 crore annual target is achievable.

risks_watch: Gold loan distribution volumes down 30-35%; recovery depends on gold price stability and new bank partners (Unity SFB signed, another pending).
Partner NBFC funding cuts of 40-50% at two or three large partners; distribution revenue dependent on third-party lending policies.
Possible pass-through of borrowing cost increases if RBI raises rates by a further 25 bps.
Management's claim on EBITDA sustainability needs tracking as operating leverage was the main driver.
Activation of only about 12-14% of EWA-registered employees; cross-sell success through Emerald Ekam is unproven.
Audience questions on the corporate onboarding count and the 2-3 year targets were not answered with specific figures.
summary.management_tone: Confident on profit growth and cost control, but cautious on gold loans and distribution, which management attributed to regulatory and market conditions. Answers on multi-year targets were vague, and management repeatedly stressed steady, controlled growth over aggressive expansion.
key_quotes: So we keep a very tight leash on expenses.
We are not going bizzare, we are not going all guns blazing.
But still we have been able to maintain, almost steady momentum.

growth.why: Management guides MSME book to INR150 crores-plus by FY27 end (from INR131 crores), EWA disbursement up 15-20% QoQ, and gold syndication target of INR1,300 crores; backing is partial (corporate onboarding 24 of 120 target, Unity bank partner, MSME book size) with no new capacity, while gold loan volumes are down 30-35%.
